mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, we are looking at 48 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library under a waning crescent moon.

The city wants to keep you informed with the latest updates from the Public Works Department, which handles everything from street maintenance to utilities. You can also sign up for the city digital newsletter to stay connected with local programs and news.

We have plenty going on in town, including Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy Hop Haus Trivia on Thursday, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, plus the Dane County Farmer's Market this Saturday.
In a noteworthy call for service on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I after he was discovered stopped at an intersection for an extended period.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. If you are planning a visit, please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
